en.headline: ICAC charges four over alleged conflict of interest at AlipayHK operator
en.dek: Two former employees of the Ant Group subsidiary and their spouses are accused of concealing interests and securing an app-development contract for a company they controlled; they face conspiracy-to-defraud charges on Thursday.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged four people on Tuesday with conspiracy to defraud in connection with an alleged conflict of interest involving Alipay Payment Services (HK) Limited, the Ant Group subsidiary that operates the AlipayHK e-wallet.

The defendants are a former senior business-development specialist and a former senior business-development manager of APSHK, together with their respective wives. According to the ICAC, the two employees are alleged to have funded and operated an application-development firm while arranging for their spouses to serve as its sole directors and shareholders. They are further alleged to have used their positions to cause APSHK to award a contract for the “eHealth Appointment” mini-programme to that firm between November 2022 and June 2025.

Ant Group and APSHK rules prohibit staff from operating or investing in external technology developers that do business with the company and require disclosure of conflicts of interest. The ICAC said the development firm collected commissions of about 5 to 8 per cent from medical institutions for transactions processed through the mini-programme. The four defendants have been released on bail and are due to appear at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴AlipayHK兩前僱員及配偶涉隱瞞利益衝突
zh.dek: 兩名前僱員被指出資經營應用程式開發商並安排配偶任董事，誘使公司將「醫健約」小程式合約外判予該公司；四人被控串謀詐騙，周四提堂。
body: 廉政公署周二落案起訴四人串謀詐騙，案件涉及營運AlipayHK電子錢包的螞蟻集團子公司Alipay Payment Services (HK) Limited（APSHK）的利益衝突指控。
四名被告包括APSHK前高級業務發展專家、前高級業務發展經理，以及兩人的妻子。廉署指，兩名前僱員涉嫌出資及經營一家應用程式開發商，並安排配偶擔任該公司唯一股東及董事，再利用職權令APSHK在2022年11月至2025年6月期間，將「醫健約」小程式的外判技術開發合約批予該公司。
螞蟻集團及APSHK訂有明確規定，禁止僱員經營或投資與公司有業務往來的外判技術開發商，並要求申報利益衝突。廉署表示，涉案開發商就「醫健約」交易向醫療機構收取約5%至8%佣金。四人已獲准保釋，星期四在東區裁判法院答辯。
